title: Alien Mage Council
description: A grey alien in ornate white and gold robes sits centrally holding a glowing green orb, flanked by a small red alien holding a purple orb and a tall blue alien balancing three stacked orbs on its head. They stand within a circular purple chamber filled with magical artifacts, floating glowing orbs, open scrolls, red books, and crystals arranged on tiered stone shelves.
prompt: A grey alien wizard wearing ornate cream and gold robes sits in the center of a circular purple arcane chamber, holding a glowing green orb. To his left stands a small red alien holding a purple orb, to his right a tall slender blue alien with three glowing orbs stacked on its head. The room is filled with floating magical orbs in red, green and blue, open scrolls with diagrams, red books, glowing crystals on stone shelves, mystical symbols on the floor, and scattered green leaves, in a detailed fantasy illustration style.
